description.narrative: The impact goal of this project is that conflict-affected children survive, learn and are protected. Outcomes are 1) Conflict-affected children are protected and have access to protection services; 2) Girls and boys are safe at school and learn; and 3) Community-based protection mechanisms are strengthened, with children's active participation. All country programs receiving Telethon funding have mainstreamed inclusion of children with disabilities as well as gender equality and the empowerment of girls in their programming. This is especially pertinent in inclusive education responses, in case management with follow-up of and support to individual children, and in community awareness raising.
